message.content: {"output_action": "CREATE", "skill_draft": {"name": "prioritize_tool_analysis_over_visual_modality_assumption", "description": "When provided with an image file for medical interpretation, do not bypass analysis tools based on internal visual classification of the image modality.", "applicable_conditions": "Tasks involving the interpretation of provided medical image files where specific diagnostic tools (e.g., classifiers, report generators) are available for that modality.", "branch": "task_level", "tool_name": null, "task_category": ["medical_imaging_interpretation"], "required_tools": ["chest_xray_classifier", "chest_xray_report_generator"], "risk_level": "high", "core_action": "If an image file is provided for analysis: (1) Do NOT rely on internal visual inspection to determine modality or reject tools; (2) Immediately invoke the relevant domain-specific analysis tools (e.g., `chest_xray_classifier`, `chest_xray_report_generator`) associated with the suspected or stated modality; (3) Use the structured output from these tools as the primary evidence for answering the query."}, "patch_target_id": null, "patch_section": null, "patch_content": null}
